event_name: MOPAR NHRA Las Vegas Nationals powered by Dodge

pairs.note:
Erica Enders is a six-time Pro Stock World Champion, most recently in 2023. She has 49 Pro Stock
national event wins, and her most recent victory was at Indy in 2025. This is her 408th race overall
and her 19th at this event; her first appearance here was in 2005. Her best starting position here is
first, achieved in 2014, 2015, and 2022. She has 42 career No. 1 starting positions. Her average
starting position is 5.1 at this event and 5.8 for her career.

Matt Latino has two national event final-round appearances, including one in 2026. His most recent
final was at Charlotte in 2026. This is his 30th race overall and his second at this event; his first
appearance here was in 2025, when he qualified eighth. His career-best starting position is second,
and his career average starting position is 7.4.

Enders is straight down the groove with a good pass.  He goes to the number two spot.  
Erica Enders' incremental times: 60ft-0.988 sec., 330ft-2.774, 660ft-4.274/163.75 mph, 1,000ft-5.569.

Latino with a good clean pass to go to the number three spot. 
Matt Latino's incremental times: 60ft-0.995 sec., 330ft-2.788, 660ft-4.287/163.61 mph, 1,000ft-5.581.

Jeg Coughlin is a five-time Pro Stock World Champion, most recently in 2013, and has 69 Pro Stock
national event wins. His most recent win was in Dallas in 2024. This is his 515th race overall and
his 22nd at this event; his first appearance here was in 2001. His best starting position here is
first, in 2008 and 2018, and his career best is first, achieved 35 times. His average starting
position is 6.6 at this event and 7.1 for his career.

Cody Anderson has one national event final-round appearance. His most recent final was at Rockingham
in 2026. This is his 19th race overall and his first at this event. His career-best starting position
is second, at Sonoma in 2026, and his career average starting position is 7.5. He has qualified in
the top half of the field at 12 of his 18 races this year and is 5-4 in the Countdown.

Coughlin is straight down the groove with a good pass.

Anderson with a good pass.

Aaron Stanfield has 17 Pro Stock national event wins, including three in 2026. His most recent win
was in St. Louis in 2026. This is his 131st race overall and his ninth at this event; his first
appearance here was in 2014. His best starting position here is second, achieved in 2022 and 2025,
and his career-best starting position is first, which he has earned five times. His average starting
position is 7.0 at this event and 6.5 for his career.

Troy Coughlin Jr. has six Pro Stock national event wins, including one in 2026. His most recent win
was at Martin in 2026. This is his 135th race overall and his seventh at this event; his first
appearance here was in 2020. His best starting position here is sixth, in 2022, and his career best
is first, achieved four times. His average starting position is 11.8 at this event and 8.8 for his
career.

Stanfield with severe tire shake right at the hit and pushed in the clutch.

Coughlin Jr. also, has severe tire shake and clicked it off.

Greg Anderson is a six-time Pro Stock World Champion, most recently in 2024, and has 116 national
event wins. He has four wins in 2026, with his most recent at Brainerd. This is his 590th race
overall and his 25th at this event; his first appearance here was in 2002. His best starting position
here is first, achieved nine times, and his career best is also first, achieved 147 times. His
average starting position is 4.0 at this event and 4.5 for his career.

Matt Hartford has 11 Pro Stock national event wins, including three in 2026. His most recent win was
at Bristol in 2026. This is his 231st race overall and his 17th at this event; his first appearance
here was in 2006. His best starting position here is third, in 2018, and his career best is first,
achieved eight times. His average starting position is 8.2 at this event and 8.4 for his career.

Anderson launched hard and kept it hooked up to go to the number one spot. 
Greg Anderson's incremental times: 60ft-0.974 sec., 330ft-2.764, 660ft-4.265/163.59 mph,
1,000ft-5.561. 

Hartford started to rattle the tires and drove through it to go to the number seven spot.

Greg Stanfield has six Pro Stock national event wins, including two in 2026. His most recent win was
at Rockingham in 2026. This is his 270th Pro Stock race and his 12th at this event; his first
appearance here was in 2002. His best starting position here is third, in 2002, while his career best
is first, achieved six times. His average starting position is 10.4 at this event and 10.0 for his
career.

Dallas Glenn is the 2025 Pro Stock World Champion and the 2021 Rookie of the Year. He has 26 Pro
Stock national event wins, including five in 2026. His most recent win was in Dallas in 2026. This is
his 110th race overall and his sixth at this event; his first appearance here was in 2021. His best
starting position here is third, in 2021, and his career-best starting position is first, achieved 15
times. His average starting position is 5.4 at this event and 4.9 for his career.

Stanfield kept it hooked up and goes to the number one spot.  
Greg Stanfield's incremental times: 60ft-0.974 sec., 330ft-2.758, 660ft-4.259/163.37 mph,
1,000ft-5.558. 

Glenn is straight down the groove with  clean pass. Dallas Glenn's incremental times: 60ft-0.987
sec., 330ft-2.789, 660ft-4.291/163.63 mph, 1,000ft-5.588.
